name: Point Hacks
description:
The Point Hacks MCP App helps you discover and compare current Australian credit card and frequent flyer offers with sign-up bonuses, annual fees, minimum spend, earn rates, and estimated points, all without leaving Claude.

Ask Claude to compare cards offers for Qantas or Velocity Points, list current Point Hacks card offers, or open a detailed preview of a specific card. Interactive views let you filter the catalog, browse card offers one at a time, and open Point Hacks card guides on www.pointhacks.com.au.

Tools:
• Compare Australian credit cards — browse card offers with filters and estimated points
• Credit card offer details — single-card preview UI with guide link
• List Australian credit card offers — catalog with guideUrl for each card.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Point Hacks to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Point Hacks to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-app.pointhacks.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Point Hacks MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Point Hacks scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Point Hacks MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Point Hacks provides these MCP tools: credit-card-finder, credit-card-preview, and list-credit-card-previews.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Point Hacks?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Point Hacks in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Skimetric, and TiCATi.

_published_faq.name: Does Point Hacks MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Point Hacks does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Point Hacks is developed by Point Hacks. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
